reactor_type: showerhead type ALD system (NCD Co., Lucida M100PL)
evidence: The precursor was contained in stainless-steel bubbler and evaporated at 45 °C to obtain sufficient vapor pressure. Precursor vapors were transported into the reaction chamber by Ar carrier gas with a flow rate of 50 sccm. Furthermore, Ar gas with the same flow rate was also used to purge excess gas molecules and byproducts between each precursor and reactant exposure step. The substrate temperature varied from 100 °C to 250 °C.
